readings.distinction: A strict syntax reading treats “all of which” as attaching to every one of the three enumerated factors and “must be present” as requiring their conjunction. The final “and” confirms coordination; no negation or alternative connective appears. “One or more” operates within the regulated-activity factor and does not make the three factors alternatives.
